task.title: 证据索引与本地检索
development_checklist: 检索路径与项目授权强制校验；缓存key包含project、source/hash、index版本及权限变化。
Sirchmunk只做检索；固定版本读源码并通过本机资格后采用，不以README代替性能证据。
缓存过期、文档删除、越界路径、同名文件与同源转载作为必测反例。

parent_gate_checks.check: 执行C19同源传播及A06隔离/失效/撤回断言。
parent_gate_checks.expected: 引用可追溯，缓存与模拟材料不能冒充当前真实证据。

parent_gate_checks.check: 用真实本地文件完成检索、更新、删除、越界路径与回退。
parent_gate_checks.expected: 索引不取代源；Sirchmunk资格失败时已验证FTS/rg可用。

cards.title: 统一证据谱系与真实原文定位
actions: 封存原文Artifact与Evidence：source URL/revision/hash/locator/type/observed_at，不将摘要替代原文。
让同源转载合并但保留引用链；源更新/撤销使下游证据STALE/REVOKED，传播到依赖判定。
实现本地检索与引用返回，命中必须通过项目权限和当前source hash重验。
基线使用本地现有索引；Sirchmunk只在固定源码资格合格后替代适配器。
deliverables: 回答和候选的每项依据可回到具体原文片段与当前权限。
反例：SIMULATED伪装OBSERVED、同名文件跨项目泄露、撤销后缓存继续命中均失败。

checks.expected: 回答和候选的每项依据可回到具体原文片段与当前权限。
反例：SIMULATED伪装OBSERVED、同名文件跨项目泄露、撤销后缓存继续命中均失败。
保存实际输入/代码/产物hash、命令/退出码和未通过项；独立复核当前产物后才接受本卡。

actions: 逐项核对父任务development_checklist/task_gate_checks，所有必须项有当前输入和原始证据。
只运行该父任务拥有的正式用例；引用其他用例作为中间集成检查，不夺取其final owner。

registry.finding: All six W09-99 frozen entry templates and the W09-02 subcard template lack their exact selectors in the active v2.4 registry; W09-01 remains bound. v2.4 key presence takes precedence over legacy BOUND entries. Old handlers/Go tests exist, but formal dispatch is not bound.

test.retrieval.note: registered by W09-01: check_id W09-01 is served by tests/evidence/check/main.py, which drives the real domain evidence and retrieval path through go test -json over internal/domain and reports the W0901-* roster it observes; it reads RESEARCHOS_TASK_ID / RESEARCHOS_CHECK_ID as injected by the dispatcher and answers no other binding, asserted by its own routing rows plus a depth-capped self-probe. This key did not exist before this card and the plan also lists it for W09-02 and W09-99: those selectors are NOT claimed here, and dispatching them resolves the key and is refused on the selector check. argv, env and timeout are copied from the accepted test.domain entry so the toolchain is the same locked one; the handler resolves go from execution/toolchains/locked.json and refuses a PATH fallback.

test.research.fixture.note: registered by W08-01: check_id W08-01 is served by tests/research/check/main.go, which drives the production HTTP+SQLite handler for the frozen ReuseDecisionPayload guard, the four-stage projection, the durable record path and the J01 judge-before-reusing gate. The program reads RESEARCHOS_TASK_ID / RESEARCHOS_CHECK_ID, which the dispatcher injects from the selectors, and refuses any binding other than W08/W08-01 as assertion W0801-ROUTING-TRUTH-TABLE. This key did not exist before this card: the plan lists it for W08-01, W08-02, W08-99 and W09-99, and those selectors are NOT claimed here - dispatching them resolves the key and is refused on the selector check, which is asserted in the receipt rather than assumed. argv, env and timeout are copied from the accepted test.domain entry so the toolchain is the same locked one. Codex recovery: W08-02 now executes the durable cycle coalescing, report-origin/continuation and cancellation/recompile no-progress witnesses; W08-01 retains its original branch. W08-99/W09-99 remain unbound.

test.security.note: registered by the W02 registry owner as the W17-01 binding line requires (same continuation disclosure as test.domain/contracts.validate); real handler is the Go program under tests/security/check. The legacy execution/commands.json key of the same name stays untouched and still points at ops/ci/retrieval.py for W09-G02/W17-G03; v2.4 resolution prefers this registry.

test.security.scope: W09_AUTHORIZED_LOCAL_SOURCES_ONLY; W17 C02/C22 and G03 strictly FIXTURE, other W17 gates/cases unbound
